value: Accumulated years of MA use negatively correlated with GMV in the right superior frontal gyrus, the right superior temporal cortex, and the right caudate nucleus at 6 months' abstinence.
These findings suggested that the right superior frontal gyrus responded to drug-use patterns as MA use accumulated.
